pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pPlaced three-input Atomic calculation. It uses the atomic recipe family and ordinary server process overrides.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Open an Atomic recipe and collect all three input requirements.$p2. Put them in the machine input area and supply power if required.$p3. Leave the result area free and verify the owner’s research access.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA Basic or Scientific recipe will not match simply because its ingredients fit the available slots.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
